headline: DeepSeek's Flash Model Hits 11.1% — Day 3 of Dominance
summary: DeepSeek/deepseek-v4-flash-20260731 just set an all-time token-share record at 11.1%, claiming the #1 spot for the third consecutive day and pushing its provider to 26.7% overall. The shake-up rippled through the top 10: Anthropic surged 2.2 percentage points on the day (now 7.6% provider share), while OpenAI dipped 1.7 points despite strong 7-day and 30-day gains. Five new models entered the rankings, and five dropped out.
highlights: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-20260731 reaches 11.1% token share (all-time high, day 3 of streak)
DeepSeek provider now commands 26.7% of traffic (+1.2% today, +8.5% in 30 days)
Anthropic jumps +2.2 percentage points to 7.6% provider share on strong individual model gains
OpenAI slips to 11.2% provider share (−1.7% today) despite gpt-5.6-luna and gpt-5.6-terra climbing 25 ranks over 7 days
New entrants: openai/gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 (rank 39), moonshotai/kimi-k2.6-20260420 (rank 44), and three others
Dropouts: perplexity/pplx-embed-v1-0.6B, qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b, poolside/laguna-xs-2.1-20260625:free, mistralai/mistral-nemo, qwen/qwen3.7-flash-20260727
